paragraphs: From Shannon test centre on Clenagh ED, move off and take the 1st left, staying on Clenagh ED for a short distance
Take the next right onto Bóthar an Aerfoirt and follow it for around half a kilometre until you reach the roundabout with the R471
At the roundabout, go straight through, taking the 2nd exit, and continue onto Drumgeely Road
Follow Drumgeely Road ahead until you reach the next roundabout, where you take the exit on the left onto Fergus Road
Stay on Fergus Road for a couple of hundred metres continue along Fergus Road
Take the next right to stay on Fergus Road before reaching Drumgeely Roundabout
Take the slight left exit at the rotary, then go straight through the following roundabout on Drumgeely Road, taking the left exit
Take the right onto Gort Road and follow it for about 600 metres
Turn right onto Bóthar na Rinne take another right to remain on Bóthar na Rinne
Follow the local road, complete a safe U-turn where indicated, and rejoin Clenagh ED
Turn left back onto Bóthar na Rinne and continue for about a kilometre to the next roundabout
At the roundabout exit left onto Bóthar an Aerfoirt
Take the slight left to stay on it the road becomes Bóthar Mór, leading you to a rotary where you take the slight left onto Bóthar An Droichead
Follow this road for around 1.4 km, then rejoin it heading back for the return leg
Take the on-ramp on the left for the R471, then use the slight left off-ramp for the N18
Turn right onto Drumline ED and follow it through the next right, staying on Drumline ED for over a kilometre
Take the slight left off-ramp, go left at the rotary and follow the slight left exit
Take the final right to return toward Shannon test centre
